subject: general
question: The speed of a boat in still water is 14 km/h. It goes 28 km downstream in 1 h 45 min. Find the speed of the stream.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of a boat in still water = 14 km/h

Distance covered = 28 km 

Time taken while doing downstream = 1 hour 45 minutes 

**Formulas used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of boat + Speed of stream 

Time = Distance/Speed </p
